name: LightCarbon LCR018-D
why_interesting: A light aero-endurance carbon frameset with an official measured-width 38 mm limit and a documented 8.6 kg Shimano 105 owner build.

facts.frame: LightCarbon LCR018-D aero-endurance all-road carbon frameset with UDH
facts.frame_material: Toray T800, T1100 and M40J carbon
facts.frame_construction: 3D latex-mandrel monocoque with full internal routing, optional down-tube storage and replaceable UDH
facts.stiffness_evidence: LightCarbon publishes qualitative stiffness and load-path claims for its Eagle Eye tube shaping; no independent measured exact-model stiffness result is included
facts.frame_weight_basis: Official size-52 frame weight, 1,100 g ±4%; the size range is 1,040–1,190 g, fork 430 g ±4% and seatpost 180 g ±10 g
facts.bottom_bracket: T47×P1, 85.5 mm on the manufacturer page; the Xianyu listing says 86.5 mm, so the 1 mm conflict remains explicit
facts.tire_clearance_basis: Manufacturer measured-width 38 mm maximum, also repeated by the exact Xianyu listing; larger owner fits are not treated as a universal limit
facts.brakes: Flat-mount disc, compatible with 140 or 160 mm rotors according to the exact Xianyu listing
facts.cockpit: HBR17 integrated carbon cockpit, approximately 300 g according to the exact Xianyu listing
facts.seatpost: 0 mm or 15 mm offset options according to the exact Xianyu listing
facts.geometry: Listing ranges: 61–68 mm trail, 74–78 mm bottom-bracket drop, 415 mm chainstays, 71–72.6° head angle and approximately 1.45–1.50 stack/reach
facts.warranty: Two-year quality warranty stated by both the manufacturer page and the exact Xianyu listing; claim route and mainland seller handling remain unverified

source_note: The official manufacturer page supplies the materials, construction, size-specific weights and measured-width 38 mm maximum. The exact Xianyu listing adds geometry ranges, brake, seatpost, cockpit-weight, storage and warranty detail and also repeats 38C, while its 86.5 mm bottom-bracket wording remains a recorded conflict with the official 85.5 mm figure. The separate size-58 owner build supplies the 8.6 kg complete weight and price references; those observations are not treated as current mainland offers.
